backend.name: fake_sherbrooke
backend.snapshot_noise_hash_scope: Existing C44 context hashes are verified as locked provenance values; no Aer simulator is run or noise-model calibration is recomputed.

environment.verification_scope: Exact Python/Qiskit/Aer distributions, frozen environment metadata/lock byte hashes, FakeSherbrooke backend identity/width/basis; all-hash transpile-summary replay is recorded separately.

existing_source_dag_cross_check.use: Read-only cross-check; the new source graph is independently reconstructed from exact-hash QASM in the frozen Terra environment.

graph_record_schema.edges: Deduplicated sorted directed pairs from previous-touch dependencies over quantum and classical wires.
graph_record_schema.gate_vocabulary: Not fitted/materialized in E2; E4 must construct fold-local vocabulary from training hashes only.
graph_record_schema.parameter_encoding: parameter_values_over_pi and parameter_presence_masks are fixed length 4; no angle reduction.
graph_record_schema.sparse_wire_encoding: qargs/cargs index lists represent fixed 127-wide multi-hot quantum/classical wire blocks; E4 expands them when forming node tensors.

reader_claim: Independent Azizov-style local source/hybrid/transpiled graph+global MLP adaptation with explicit51/64/51 inputs, frozen noisy-Aer warm labels and shared exact-hash folds; no paper-exact or published-accuracy reproduction claim.
scope: Static feature and graph materialization plus deterministic transpile-summary preflight; no model fit, Aer simulation, runtime measurement, or GPU inspection.

package_graph_payloads.record_boundary: newline; concatenate ordered shard bytes to recover original payload exactly

upstream.code_import_policy: The pinned blobs are verified from Git objects; no live upstream Python module is imported.
